desc.zh: sin 是身高、cos 是站位、tan 是斜率——三个函数是同一个圆的三个投影。拖着点绕一圈，看正弦波从圆的侧影里长出来；这一页是傅里叶变换的前传。
desc.en: Sine is a height, cosine a position, tangent a slope — three functions that are three projections of one circle. Drag the point around and watch the sine wave grow out of the circle's silhouette; this page is the prequel to the Fourier transform.
